recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white group portrait featuring four men in urban attire, characterized by extreme wide-angle distortion, aggressive facial expressions, and a claustrophobic, multi-layered composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme foreground proximity vs. distant center subject
Harsh directional lighting vs. deep shadow pockets
Distorted facial features vs. sharp textural details like teeth and fabric

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects are positioned in the extreme foreground, their faces cropped by the frame edges; a fourth subject is centered in the mid-ground, appearing smaller due to lens distortion.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's direct gaze and the bright metallic glint of the foreground subject's teeth.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye circulates between the large, distorted faces at the corners, eventually settling on the smaller, full-bodied figure in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with faces and dark clothing, creating a sense of urgency and confrontation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (highlights on skin, teeth, and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast with crushed blacks and blown-out highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Curvilinear baseline following the shape of the headwear
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to follow the contour of a beanie cap

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, traditional street-gothic aesthetic
Provides the necessary sharp angles and verticality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photo of four men in 90s streetwear (beanies, bandanas, work jackets). Use a fisheye lens effect. Three men are extremely close to the camera, one is further back. One man shows silver grillz on his teeth. Harsh lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a light gray Gothic/Blackletter script to the front of the central foreground beanie, following the curved contour of the forehead.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Does the text follow the curve of the hat?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present.
Check that the fisheye distortion doesn't blur the central subject's face.
Verify the metallic texture on the teeth looks reflective.
Confirm the background is blown out to white/light gray.
recipe.reuseFormula: Wide-angle distortion + High-contrast B&W + Urban grit + Layered foreground/background subjects.
